name.es: Registro de cabilderos del Condado Miami-Dade

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every item the commission finally decided from November 19, 2020 (the first meeting after Commissioner Gilbert was sworn in) through October 6, 2026 that gives a named private company, developer or group a contract, lease, county land, zoning or plat approval, money or a change to an existing deal, read from the Clerk of the Board's minutes of 233 commission and zoning meetings. 2,351 final actions from November 2020 to November 2025 whose title names no private party are left out, as are routine items. Each vote comes from the minutes and was checked against the tally the clerk printed. Commissioner Lopez joined on November 18, 2025, so earlier items show her as not yet seated.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada asunto que la comisión decidió en forma final desde el 19 de noviembre de 2020 (la primera reunión después de que el comisionado Gilbert juramentó) hasta el 6 de octubre de 2026 que otorga a una empresa privada, desarrollador o grupo con nombre un contrato, arrendamiento, terreno del condado, aprobación de zonificación o de plat, dinero o un cambio a un acuerdo existente, según las actas de la Secretaría de la Junta de 233 reuniones de la comisión y de zonificación. Se dejan fuera 2351 actos finales de noviembre de 2020 a noviembre de 2025 cuyo título no nombra a una parte privada, y los asuntos de rutina. Cada voto viene de las actas y se comparó con el conteo que publicó la secretaría. La comisionada Lopez entró el 18 de noviembre de 2025, así que los asuntos anteriores la muestran como aún no en el cargo.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak dosye komisyon an te deside nèt depi 19 novanm 2020 (premye reyinyon apre Komisyonè Gilbert te prete sèman) rive 6 oktòb 2026 ki bay yon konpayi prive, yon devlopè oswa yon gwoup ki gen non yon kontra, yon lokasyon, tè konte, yon apwobasyon zonaj oswa plat, lajan oswa yon chanjman nan yon akò ki la deja, selon pwosè-vèbal Grefye Konsèy la pou 233 reyinyon komisyon ak zonaj. Nou pa mete 2351 aksyon final ant novanm 2020 ak novanm 2025 ki pa nonmen okenn pati prive nan tit yo, ni dosye woutin yo. Chak vòt soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo epi nou konpare l ak kantite vòt grefye a pibliye. Komisyonè Lopez te antre 18 novanm 2025, kidonk dosye ki vin anvan yo montre li poko te chita.

name.es: Comisión de la Ciudad de Coral Gables
Registro de cabilderos de Coral Gables, 2024-2026

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Coral Gables City Commission took from April 13, 2013 to October 13, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 358 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. A lobbyist registration counts if it is in the city's list for the year of the vote or was filed within the year before. Vince Lago's campaign reports from 2013 through 2019 are not in this data (the earliest report here is dated January 2020), so donor ties on his 2013-2020 votes are understated. 96 more actions benefit a party the record does not name, so they are not listed or counted.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto de la Comisión de la Ciudad de Coral Gables entre el 13 de abril de 2013 y el 13 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 358 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. Un registro de cabildero cuenta si está en la lista de la ciudad del año del voto o se presentó dentro del año anterior. Los informes de campaña de Vince Lago de 2013 a 2019 no están en estos datos (el informe más antiguo aquí es de enero de 2020), así que los vínculos con donantes en sus votos de 2013 a 2020 están subestimados. Otros 96 actos benefician a una parte que el registro no nombra, así que no se muestran ni se cuentan.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Komisyon Vil Coral Gables te pran ant 13 avril 2013 ak 13 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 358 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Yon anrejistreman lobiyis konte si li nan lis vil la pou ane vòt la oswa si yo te depoze l nan ane anvan an. Rapò kanpay Vince Lago depi 2013 rive 2019 yo pa nan done sa yo (pi ansyen rapò isit la se janvye 2020), kidonk lyen ak donatè sou vòt li te bay ant 2013 ak 2020 yo pi piti pase reyalite a. 96 lòt aksyon benefisye yon pati dosye a pa nonmen, kidonk nou pa montre yo ni konte yo.

name.es: Concejo de la Ciudad de Doral

name.en: Doral authorized lobbyists and their principals (current list)
name.es: Cabilderos autorizados de Doral y sus clientes (lista actual)
name.ht: Lobiyis otorize Doral ak kliyan yo (lis kounye a)

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Doral City Council took from December 20, 2022 to September 22, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 95 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. Doral posts only its current lobbyist list (registrations from December 2025 on), so a 2025 item can show a lobbyist registered after the vote. 7 more actions benefit a party the record does not name, so they are not listed or counted.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto del Concejo de la Ciudad de Doral entre el 20 de diciembre de 2022 y el 22 de septiembre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 95 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. Doral publica solo su lista actual de cabilderos (registros desde diciembre de 2025), así que un asunto de 2025 puede mostrar un cabildero registrado después del voto. Otros 7 actos benefician a una parte que el registro no nombra, así que no se muestran ni se cuentan.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Konsèy Vil Doral te pran ant 20 desanm 2022 ak 22 septanm 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 95 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Doral pibliye sèlman lis lobiyis aktyèl li (anrejistreman depi desanm 2025), kidonk yon dosye 2025 ka montre yon lobiyis ki te anrejistre apre vòt la. 7 lòt aksyon benefisye yon pati dosye a pa nonmen, kidonk nou pa montre yo ni konte yo.

Votes are as the minutes record them. Consent items carry the consent motion vote with attendance from the roll call at the start of the meeting session (morning or evening) in which the item was heard.

Amounts are taken from item titles; many items say only "not to exceed budgeted funds" and have amount null. Grant totals are summed from the listed awards.

Excluded by rule: proclamations, presentations, board nominations, budget/millage ordinances, job descriptions and pay plans, the city manager, police chief and inspector general employment items, generic code text amendments without a named applicant, interlocal/mutual aid/MOU items with only government parties, budget transfers with no named vendor, and items withdrawn, deferred or tabled without a final vote.
Local Planning Agency sessions (transmittal recommendations only) were read but not counted as Council actions; the same items appear as Council first/second reading votes.
Item 25-6177 (city attorney retainer increase) appears approved on consent at both the May 14 and June 4, 2025 meetings; both are listed.
Item 25-6320 (Pereyra-Diaz settlement) failed 2-3 and is listed with result failed.

Tenure extension (2022-12-20 to 2024-12-31): every Council, Zoning and Special Council meeting with final minutes on Granicus (52 meetings, 2022-12-21 to 2024-12-26) was read; Local Planning Agency sessions and workshops were not counted. Votes come from the minutes text: consent items carry the consent motion vote, other items the motion recorded for that item, with absences from the minutes. Oscar Puig-Corve (Vice Mayor, seated through 2024-12) appears in these rolls under the key PuigCorve. 7 listed actions name no private party.
Tenure extension: Doral posts only current lobbyist registrations, so no registry links exist for 2022-2024 items; the minutes name no lobbyist appearing for a party on a listed item.

Tenure extension: three motions whose printed tally does not match the members named (for example "4-2" on a five-member council: 23-5300 budget, 24-5475 ADT/Security 101 negotiation, Ord. 2024-29 boards) carry no parsed roll; of these only 24-5475 is listed, with the two no votes the minutes name and the other three unknown.

name.es: Comisión de la Ciudad de Aventura
Cabilderos registrados de Aventura (lista del 6 de mayo de 2026)

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Aventura City Commission took from December 15, 2022 to October 6, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 64 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. Some 2026 resolutions are scans; their votes were read from the page images. The June 13, 2024 special meeting has no minutes; its actions come from the signed resolutions. Mayor Weinberg's 2020-2022 donor reports are handwritten; one page of his June 2021 report could not be read, so about $5,000 in gifts is not counted.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto de la Comisión de la Ciudad de Aventura entre el 15 de diciembre de 2022 y el 6 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 64 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. Algunas resoluciones de 2026 son imágenes escaneadas; sus votos se leyeron de las imágenes. La reunión especial del 13 de junio de 2024 no tiene acta; sus actos vienen de las resoluciones firmadas. Los informes de donantes del alcalde Weinberg de 2020-2022 están escritos a mano; una página de su informe de junio de 2021 no se pudo leer, así que no se cuentan unos $5,000 en donaciones.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Komisyon Vil Aventura te pran ant 15 desanm 2022 ak 6 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 64 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Kèk rezolisyon 2026 se imaj eskane; nou li vòt yo nan imaj paj yo. Reyinyon espesyal 13 jen 2024 la pa gen pwosè-vèbal; aksyon li yo soti nan rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Rapò donatè majistra Weinberg 2020-2022 yo ekri alamen; nou pa t ka li yon paj nan rapò jen 2021 li a, kidonk anviwon $5,000 an don pa konte.

name.es: Cabilderos registrados de North Miami Beach, 2023
Cabilderos registrados de North Miami Beach, 2024

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the North Miami Beach City Commission took from November 22, 2022 to August 27, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 106 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. Most minutes are scans read by text recognition, and most votes are voice votes: members the minutes do not name as absent or voting no are shown voting yes. Minutes after August 27, 2026 are not posted. The January 17, February 21 and November 14, 2023 meetings had no quorum and took no votes. The 2018 and 2022 donor reports are handwritten and were read from the page images; Commissioner Chernoff's 2022 runoff report itemizes $35,249 of the $36,360 it reports.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto de la Comisión de la Ciudad de North Miami Beach entre el 22 de noviembre de 2022 y el 27 de agosto de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 106 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. La mayoría de las actas son imágenes escaneadas leídas con reconocimiento de texto, y la mayoría de los votos son de viva voz: los miembros que el acta no nombra como ausentes o en contra aparecen votando a favor. No hay actas publicadas después del 27 de agosto de 2026. Las reuniones del 17 de enero, 21 de febrero y 14 de noviembre de 2023 no tuvieron quórum ni votaciones. Los informes de donantes de 2018 y 2022 están escritos a mano y se leyeron de las imágenes; el informe de la segunda vuelta de 2022 del comisionado Chernoff detalla $35,249 de los $36,360 que declara.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Komisyon Vil North Miami Beach te pran ant 22 novanm 2022 ak 27 out 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 106 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Pifò pwosè-vèbal se imaj eskane nou li ak rekonesans tèks, epi pifò vòt se vòt vwa: manm pwosè-vèbal la pa nonmen kòm absan oswa ki vote non parèt kòm vote wi. Pa gen pwosè-vèbal pibliye apre 27 out 2026. Reyinyon 17 janvye, 21 fevriye ak 14 novanm 2023 yo pa t gen kowòm epi pa t gen vòt. Rapò donatè 2018 ak 2022 yo ekri alamen epi nou li yo nan imaj paj yo; rapò dezyèm tou 2022 komisyonè Chernoff la detaye $35,249 sou $36,360 li deklare a.

Chernoff.en: Resolution R2025-62. Prokel Mobility’s gift lists the same Boca Raton address as Pro Transportation in the city’s lobbyist registry. We Strategize is Mackenson Jeanty’s firm; Becker & Poliakoff is the firm of Prokel’s other registered lobbyists (it was also hired by the city for annexation work in June 2026).
Chernoff.es: Resolución R2025-62. La donación de Prokel Mobility indica la misma dirección en Boca Raton que Pro Transportation en el registro de cabilderos de la ciudad. We Strategize es la firma de Mackenson Jeanty; Becker & Poliakoff es el bufete de los otros cabilderos registrados de Prokel (la ciudad también lo contrató para el trabajo de anexión en junio de 2026).
Chernoff.ht: Rezolisyon R2025-62. Kado Prokel Mobility a bay menm adrès Boca Raton ak Pro Transportation nan rejis lobiyis vil la. We Strategize se konpayi Mackenson Jeanty; Becker & Poliakoff se biwo lòt lobiyis anrejistre Prokel yo (vil la te anboche l tou pou travay aneksyon an jen 2026).

Smith.en: Resolution R2025-62. The gift came 16 months after Smith voted no.
Smith.es: Resolución R2025-62. La donación llegó 16 meses después de que Smith votó en contra.
Smith.ht: Rezolisyon R2025-62. Kado a rive 16 mwa apre Smith te vote non.

Smith.en: Resolution R2023-119. Before the Dec. 19, 2023 hearing Smith disclosed speaking with Matthew Amster, Mitch Edelstein, the city attorney and a nearby resident about the item; that night she and Chernoff voted against tabling it (tabled 5-2). Matthew Amster presented for the owner.
Smith.es: Resolución R2023-119. Antes de la audiencia del 19 de diciembre de 2023 Smith declaró haber hablado con Matthew Amster, Mitch Edelstein, el abogado de la ciudad y un vecino sobre el asunto; esa noche ella y Chernoff votaron en contra de aplazarlo (se aplazó 5-2). Matthew Amster presentó por el propietario.
Smith.ht: Rezolisyon R2023-119. Anvan odyans 19 desanm 2023 la Smith te deklare li te pale ak Matthew Amster, Mitch Edelstein, avoka vil la ak yon vwazen sou dosye a; jou swa sa a li menm ak Chernoff te vote kont ranvwaye l (yo ranvwaye l 5-2). Matthew Amster te prezante pou pwopriyetè a.

note.en: The minutes contradict themselves on this vote. The roll call reads "Roll Call Vote: Jean - Yes, Joseph - Yes, Smith - Yes, Smukler - Yes, Fleurimond - Yes, Chernoff - Yes", but the next line reads "MOTION PASSED 5-1 with Commissioner Jean opposed." Commissioner Jean's vote is shown as not given.
note.es: El acta se contradice en esta votación. La votación nominal dice "Roll Call Vote: Jean - Yes, Joseph - Yes, Smith - Yes, Smukler - Yes, Fleurimond - Yes, Chernoff - Yes" (todos a favor), pero la línea siguiente dice "MOTION PASSED 5-1 with Commissioner Jean opposed." (aprobada 5-1 con la comisionada Jean en contra). El voto de la comisionada Jean aparece como no indicado.
note.ht: Rapò reyinyon an kontredi tèt li sou vòt sa a. Vòt nominal la di "Roll Call Vote: Jean - Yes, Joseph - Yes, Smith - Yes, Smukler - Yes, Fleurimond - Yes, Chernoff - Yes" (tout vote wi), men liy ki vin apre a di "MOTION PASSED 5-1 with Commissioner Jean opposed." (pase 5-1, komisyonè Jean te kont). Nou montre vòt komisyonè Jean kòm pa bay.

name.es: Concejo de la Ciudad de North Miami

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the North Miami City Council took from January 1, 2017 to October 13, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 178 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. The minutes do not name the applicant on most zoning and site-plan items, so those cannot be checked against donors. Minutes for 2015-2016, April 24 - June 12, 2018, April 7 and 14, 2020, October 27, 2020 and October 8, 2024 are not posted, so Councilman Desulme's first years on the council are not covered. Donor reports before 2024 are scans: Desulme's 2015 reports are handwritten and could not be read, and the 2019 and 2021 reports of Desulme, Estimé-Irvin and Timothé were read by text recognition and may be missing some gifts.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto del Concejo de la Ciudad de North Miami entre el 1 de enero de 2017 y el 13 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 178 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. Las actas no nombran al solicitante en la mayoría de los asuntos de zonificación y plan del sitio, así que esos no se pueden comparar con los donantes. No hay actas publicadas de 2015-2016, del 24 de abril al 12 de junio de 2018, del 7 y 14 de abril de 2020, del 27 de octubre de 2020 ni del 8 de octubre de 2024, así que los primeros años del concejal Desulme no están cubiertos. Los informes de donantes anteriores a 2024 son imágenes escaneadas: los de Desulme de 2015 están escritos a mano y no se pudieron leer, y los de 2019 y 2021 de Desulme, Estimé-Irvin y Timothé se leyeron con reconocimiento de texto y pueden faltar algunas donaciones.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Konsèy Vil North Miami te pran ant 1 janvye 2017 ak 13 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 178 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Pwosè-vèbal yo pa nonmen moun ki fè demann nan pou pifò dosye zonaj ak plan sit, kidonk nou pa ka konpare yo ak donatè yo. Pa gen pwosè-vèbal pibliye pou 2015-2016, 24 avril - 12 jen 2018, 7 ak 14 avril 2020, 27 oktòb 2020 ak 8 oktòb 2024, kidonk premye ane konseye Desulme yo pa kouvri. Rapò donatè anvan 2024 yo se imaj eskane: rapò Desulme 2015 yo ekri alamen epi nou pa t ka li yo, epi rapò 2019 ak 2021 Desulme, Estimé-Irvin ak Timothé yo te li ak rekonesans tèks e kèk don ka manke.

Desulme.en: Each member picks one Centennial Committee member; the resolution says Mayor Desulme chose McDearmaid, though he was absent for the vote. McDearmaid is vice chair of the city's Planning Commission. The donor is McDearmaid and Associates Consulting; that it is his firm is inferred from the name, not confirmed. In September 2026 the council also took up naming a street for him; that vote's record is not posted yet.
Desulme.es: Cada miembro elige a un integrante del Comité del Centenario; la resolución dice que el alcalde Desulme eligió a McDearmaid, aunque estuvo ausente en la votación. McDearmaid es vicepresidente de la Comisión de Planificación de la ciudad. El donante es McDearmaid and Associates Consulting; que sea su firma se deduce del nombre, no está confirmado. En septiembre de 2026 el concejo también consideró nombrar una calle en su honor; el registro de esa votación aún no se publica.
Desulme.ht: Chak manm chwazi yon moun pou Komite Santenè a; rezolisyon an di se majistra Desulme ki te chwazi McDearmaid, menmsi li te absan pou vòt la. McDearmaid se vis-prezidan Komisyon Planifikasyon vil la. Donatè a se McDearmaid and Associates Consulting; nou dedui se konpayi pa l la nan non an, sa pa konfime. An septanm 2026 konsèy la te pran yon dosye tou pou bay yon lari non l; dosye vòt sa a poko pibliye.

Estimé-Irvin.en: Each member picks one Centennial Committee member; the resolution says Mayor Desulme chose McDearmaid, though he was absent for the vote. McDearmaid is vice chair of the city's Planning Commission. The donor is McDearmaid and Associates Consulting; that it is his firm is inferred from the name, not confirmed. In September 2026 the council also took up naming a street for him; that vote's record is not posted yet.
Estimé-Irvin.es: Cada miembro elige a un integrante del Comité del Centenario; la resolución dice que el alcalde Desulme eligió a McDearmaid, aunque estuvo ausente en la votación. McDearmaid es vicepresidente de la Comisión de Planificación de la ciudad. El donante es McDearmaid and Associates Consulting; que sea su firma se deduce del nombre, no está confirmado. En septiembre de 2026 el concejo también consideró nombrar una calle en su honor; el registro de esa votación aún no se publica.
Estimé-Irvin.ht: Chak manm chwazi yon moun pou Komite Santenè a; rezolisyon an di se majistra Desulme ki te chwazi McDearmaid, menmsi li te absan pou vòt la. McDearmaid se vis-prezidan Komisyon Planifikasyon vil la. Donatè a se McDearmaid and Associates Consulting; nou dedui se konpayi pa l la nan non an, sa pa konfime. An septanm 2026 konsèy la te pran yon dosye tou pou bay yon lari non l; dosye vòt sa a poko pibliye.

note.en: The minutes contradict themselves on this vote. They read "Council voted roll call, passed 3-1:" but the names listed under it are "Councilwoman Timothe: Yes, Councilman Charles: No, Councilman Galvin: Yes, Vice Mayor Estimé-Irvin: No, Mayor Desulme: Absent", which is 2 yes and 2 no. The vote shown follows the named votes (2-2); the result shown follows the minutes (passed).
note.es: El acta se contradice en esta votación. Dice "Council voted roll call, passed 3-1:" (aprobada 3-1), pero los nombres que aparecen debajo son "Councilwoman Timothe: Yes, Councilman Charles: No, Councilman Galvin: Yes, Vice Mayor Estimé-Irvin: No, Mayor Desulme: Absent", es decir, 2 a favor y 2 en contra. El voto que se muestra sigue los votos nombrados (2-2); el resultado sigue el acta (aprobada).
note.ht: Rapò reyinyon an kontredi tèt li sou vòt sa a. Li di "Council voted roll call, passed 3-1:" (pase 3-1), men non ki anba a se "Councilwoman Timothe: Yes, Councilman Charles: No, Councilman Galvin: Yes, Vice Mayor Estimé-Irvin: No, Mayor Desulme: Absent", sa vle di 2 wi ak 2 non. Vòt nou montre a swiv vòt ki nonmen yo (2-2); rezilta a swiv rapò a (pase).

name.es: Comisión de la Ciudad de South Miami

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the South Miami City Commission took from November 8, 2022 to October 20, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 98 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. 15 more actions benefit a party the record does not name, so they are not listed or counted.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto de la Comisión de la Ciudad de South Miami entre el 8 de noviembre de 2022 y el 20 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 98 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. Otros 15 actos benefician a una parte que el registro no nombra, así que no se muestran ni se cuentan.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Komisyon Vil South Miami te pran ant 8 novanm 2022 ak 20 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 98 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. 15 lòt aksyon benefisye yon pati dosye a pa nonmen, kidonk nou pa montre yo ni konte yo.

name.es: Concejo de la Villa de Pinecrest

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Pinecrest Village Council took from November 8, 2022 to October 13, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 60 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. The list goes back to November 2022, when Fairman took office; minutes were read for every meeting from December 2, 2022. Campaign reports are counted from 2020. 8 more actions benefit a party the record does not name, so they are not listed or counted.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto del Concejo de la Villa de Pinecrest entre el 8 de noviembre de 2022 y el 13 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 60 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. La lista se remonta a noviembre de 2022, cuando Fairman asumió el cargo; se leyeron las actas de todas las reuniones desde el 2 de diciembre de 2022. Los informes de campaña se cuentan desde 2020. Otros 8 actos benefician a una parte que el registro no nombra, así que no se muestran ni se cuentan.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Konsèy Vilaj Pinecrest te pran ant 8 novanm 2022 ak 13 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 60 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Lis la kòmanse an novanm 2022, lè Fairman te pran pòs li; nou li pwosè-vèbal chak reyinyon depi 2 desanm 2022. Nou konte rapò kanpay depi 2020. 8 lòt aksyon benefisye yon pati dosye a pa nonmen, kidonk nou pa montre yo ni konte yo.

gaps.issue: Tenure extension (Oct 25, 2026): Fairman was elected unopposed and sworn in Nov 8, 2022 (Dec 13, 2022 minutes). Minutes Dec 2, 2022 to Dec 10, 2024 were read from the clerk minutes PDFs attached to later Legistar agendas. Minutes of Jan 10, Jan 18 and Feb 13, 2023 and of the Nov 16, 2023, Feb 7, 2024, Aug 27 and Dec 3, 2024 workshops record no private-party actions. No meetings were held Nov 2022 between the election and Dec 2.

2022-2024 consent items carry the single consent-agenda vote. Items the minutes record as approved by "consensus" during reports (HIP Program donations) are shown with every member present voting yes, as the minutes state the Council authorized unanimously.

2022-2024 excluded: interlocals with Miami-Dade County, Coral Gables and FDOT, grant acceptances, the Moskowitz Family Foundation donation to the police (2022-69, a gift to the village), budget and code ordinances, the village-owned 11855 SW 60 Ave land use and rezoning, deferrals (Frontier Building Mar 19, 2024; Urban Robot May 7, 2024), vice mayor selections, and two June 13, 2023 roundabout sculpture resolutions (2023-53, 2023-54) whose vendor is left blank in the minutes
Minutes not yet posted (they will be attached to the next regular agenda); agenda items listed with roll null

Special meeting agenda lists an offer of judgment and a settlement offer in Megladon Inc. v. Village of Pinecrest; no minutes for this special meeting were attached to any later agenda (the Feb 10, 2026 packet contains minutes of a Jan 9 workshop instead)
Special site meeting (115 Street between 70 Avenue and 69 Court) has no minutes posted; no action items on its agenda
Legistar API carries no votes, movers or tallies for Pinecrest; all votes come from the clerk minutes PDFs
Workshops and attorney-client executive sessions (Megladon litigation, 2025-07-15 through 2026-07-14) were read; they record no actions on private parties
Roll calls cover the five members present; McDonald (interim, from May 2026) replaced del Prado, whose column is null after April 2026
The Jan 14, 2025 minutes header misprints the year as 2024; dated 2025-01-14 here
Applicants for the Pinecrest Business Alternative District expansion (10420 SW 77 Avenue, 10500 SW 77 Court) are not named in the minutes

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Medley Town Council took from November 19, 2012 to October 5, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 92 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. The list goes back to November 2012, when Ayala took office (Rodriguez from November 2020). Medley's minutes archive asks for a sign-in, so no minutes from November 2012 onward could be read: the list comes from the agendas and the votes are not shown. Agendas are online only from September 2015 and were read from January 2016, so November 2012 to December 2015 is missing. Campaign reports before 2026 are not online. 40 more actions benefit a party the record does not name, so they are not listed or counted.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto del Concejo del Pueblo de Medley entre el 19 de noviembre de 2012 y el 5 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 92 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. La lista se remonta a noviembre de 2012, cuando Ayala asumió el cargo (Rodriguez desde noviembre de 2020). El archivo de actas de Medley pide iniciar sesión, así que no se pudo leer ninguna acta desde noviembre de 2012: la lista viene de las agendas y no muestra los votos. Las agendas están en línea solo desde septiembre de 2015 y se leyeron desde enero de 2016, así que falta de noviembre de 2012 a diciembre de 2015. Los informes de campaña anteriores a 2026 no están en línea. Otros 40 actos benefician a una parte que el registro no nombra, así que no se muestran ni se cuentan.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Konsèy Vil Medley te pran ant 19 novanm 2012 ak 5 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 92 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Lis la kòmanse an novanm 2012, lè Ayala te pran pòs li (Rodriguez depi novanm 2020). Achiv pwosè-vèbal Medley mande pou w konekte, kidonk nou pa t ka li okenn pwosè-vèbal depi novanm 2012: lis la soti nan ajennda yo epi li pa montre vòt yo. Ajennda yo sou entènèt sèlman depi septanm 2015 epi nou li yo depi janvye 2016, kidonk novanm 2012 rive desanm 2015 manke. Rapò kanpay anvan 2026 yo pa sou entènèt. 40 lòt aksyon benefisye yon pati dosye a pa nonmen, kidonk nou pa montre yo ni konte yo.

title.en: Accepted a right-of-way agreement with conditions from Florida Wood Recycling for the NW 89 Avenue road project (Resolution C-2251)
title.es: Aceptó un acuerdo de derecho de paso con condiciones de Florida Wood Recycling para el proyecto vial de la NW 89 Avenue (Resolución C-2251)
title.ht: Aksepte yon akò dwa pasaj ak kondisyon Florida Wood Recycling pou pwojè wout NW 89 Avenue (Rezolisyon C-2251)

Ayala.en: Florida Wood gave the town the road land it needed, with conditions: the town provides a survey and a turning radius for the company's trucks, and the company keeps using part of the right-of-way for its operations. Town staff called the deal better for the town than buying the land. Ayala moved it. The record read so far names the seconder only as Rodriguez, and two council members named Rodriguez (Lizelh and Lourdes) sat then, so Lizelh Rodriguez's vote is not known. The gifts came a year after the vote; Florida Wood also gave $250 to challenger Gloria Hernandez.
Ayala.es: Florida Wood cedió al municipio el terreno que necesitaba para la vía, con condiciones: el municipio entrega un levantamiento topográfico y un radio de giro para los camiones de la empresa, y la empresa sigue usando parte del derecho de paso para sus operaciones. El personal municipal dijo que el acuerdo era mejor para el municipio que comprar el terreno. Ayala lo propuso. El registro leído hasta ahora nombra a quien lo secundó solo como Rodriguez, y entonces había dos concejales de apellido Rodriguez (Lizelh y Lourdes), así que no se sabe el voto de Lizelh Rodriguez. Los aportes llegaron un año después de la votación; Florida Wood también dio $250 a la candidata Gloria Hernandez.
Ayala.ht: Florida Wood te bay vil la tè li te bezwen pou wout la, ak kondisyon: vil la bay yon apantaj ak yon espas pou kamyon konpayi a vire, epi konpayi a kontinye sèvi ak yon pati nan dwa pasaj la pou operasyon li. Anplwaye vil la te di akò a pi bon pou vil la pase achte tè a. Ayala te pwopoze l. Dosye nou li jiskaprezan bay non moun ki te apiye l la sèlman kòm Rodriguez, epi te gen de manm konsèy ki rele Rodriguez (Lizelh ak Lourdes) lè sa a, kidonk nou pa konnen vòt Lizelh Rodriguez. Don yo te rive yon ane apre vòt la; Florida Wood te bay kandida Gloria Hernandez $250 tou.

gaps.issue: Tenure extension (Oct 25, 2026): Ayala has served since Nov 19, 2012 and Lizelh Rodriguez since Nov 3, 2020. The town site posts agendas only from Sep 2015; 2012-11 through 2015-08 has no agendas or minutes online (all months missing). Agendas 2015-2024 were read (scanned ones by OCR) and private-party items listed with roll null; minutes for every month 2012-2024 are only in the Laserfiche library, which could not be opened, so no votes are known. The Dec 5, 2016 agenda could not be dated from its text and was skipped. 2015 agendas (Sep-Dec) were not read.

Minutes not read: medleydocs.com (Laserfiche WebLink) returned a cookie error page to the fetcher and the browser pane was refused, even after site access was granted. Every action except the July 7, 2025 Florida Wood item is listed from the agenda with roll null; outcomes, movers and votes are unknown.

No agenda posted for January 2025, February 2025, August 2025 (cancelled per July 7 agenda) or January 2026 (cancelled per Dec 1 agenda); the Sept 22, 2026 second budget hearing agenda is not on the page

Items that recur on later agendas (Florida Wood, pet crematorium, Titan Florida, Verra Mobility, Vetted Security, Res-Des Palmetto, UniCapital) were probably deferred at the earlier meeting; each listing is kept until minutes confirm the outcome
Agendas omit many vendor and claimant names (insurance renewals, vehicle purchases, settlement claimants, land sale buyer)
Member roster not confirmed; roll keys limited to Ayala and Rodriguez (the two incumbents tracked on the site)

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Hialeah City Council took from January 1, 2025 to October 13, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 45 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. The minutes for January 13, 2026 are not posted (the city's link opens the January 27 minutes), so that meeting is not included.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto del Concejo de la Ciudad de Hialeah entre el 1 de enero de 2025 y el 13 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 45 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. El acta del 13 de enero de 2026 no está publicada (el enlace de la ciudad abre el acta del 27 de enero), así que esa reunión no está incluida.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Konsèy Vil Hialeah te pran ant 1 janvye 2025 ak 13 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 45 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Pwosè-vèbal 13 janvye 2026 la pa pibliye (lyen vil la louvri pwosè-vèbal 27 janvye a), kidonk reyinyon sa a pa ladan l.

note.en: Split votes: Vice President De La Vega and Council Members Marrero and Monica Perez voted no on both ordinances, at first reading on February 24 and at second reading on March 10. Gonzalez made or seconded the motion each time. Both lobbyists are listed under the property owner; at first reading Mestre presented a document titled “Automotive Dealership Protection.” The gift came seven months after the vote.
note.es: Votaciones divididas: la vicepresidenta De La Vega y los concejales Marrero y Monica Perez votaron en contra de ambas ordenanzas, en la primera lectura del 24 de febrero y en la segunda del 10 de marzo. Gonzalez presentó o secundó la moción cada vez. Ambos cabilderos aparecen bajo el propietario; en la primera lectura Mestre presentó un documento titulado “Automotive Dealership Protection”. La donación llegó siete meses después del voto.
note.ht: Vòt divize: Vis Prezidan De La Vega ak Konseye Marrero ak Monica Perez te vote non sou toude òdonans yo, nan premye lekti 24 fevriye ak nan dezyèm lekti 10 mas. Gonzalez te fè oswa apiye mosyon an chak fwa. Toude lobiyis yo parèt anba pwopriyetè a; nan premye lekti Mestre te prezante yon dokiman ki rele “Automotive Dealership Protection.” Kado a te rive sèt mwa apre vòt la.

name.es: Concejo del Pueblo de Cutler Bay

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Cutler Bay Town Council took from November 6, 2018 to October 21, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 98 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. The list goes back to November 2018, when Duncan took office (Lord from December 2020, Ramirez from November 2022). Minutes from November 2018 to December 2020 (31 meetings) are posted only as PDF files behind a browser check that could not be opened, so actions start in January 2021 and Duncan's first two years are missing. The October 21, 2026 meeting has no minutes yet, and the minutes of March 19, 2025, March 22, 2023, June 21, 2023 and two items on January 18, 2023 do not record members' votes. Campaign reports are counted from 2016 for Duncan, 2018 for Lord and 2020 for Ramirez.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto del Concejo del Pueblo de Cutler Bay entre el 6 de noviembre de 2018 y el 21 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 98 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. La lista se remonta a noviembre de 2018, cuando Duncan asumió el cargo (Lord desde diciembre de 2020, Ramirez desde noviembre de 2022). Las actas de noviembre de 2018 a diciembre de 2020 (31 reuniones) solo están publicadas como archivos PDF detrás de una verificación del navegador que no se pudo abrir, así que los actos empiezan en enero de 2021 y faltan los dos primeros años de Duncan. La reunión del 21 de octubre de 2026 aún no tiene acta, y las actas del 19 de marzo de 2025, el 22 de marzo de 2023, el 21 de junio de 2023 y dos puntos del 18 de enero de 2023 no registran los votos de los miembros. Los informes de campaña se cuentan desde 2016 para Duncan, 2018 para Lord y 2020 para Ramirez.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Konsèy Vil Cutler Bay te pran ant 6 novanm 2018 ak 21 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 98 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Lis la kòmanse an novanm 2018, lè Duncan te pran pòs li (Lord depi desanm 2020, Ramirez depi novanm 2022). Pwosè-vèbal novanm 2018 rive desanm 2020 (31 reyinyon) pibliye sèlman an fichye PDF dèyè yon verifikasyon navigatè nou pa t ka louvri, kidonk aksyon yo kòmanse an janvye 2021 epi de premye ane Duncan yo manke. Reyinyon 21 oktòb 2026 la poko gen pwosè-vèbal, epi pwosè-vèbal 19 mas 2025, 22 mas 2023, 21 jen 2023 ak de pwen 18 janvye 2023 pa make vòt manm yo. Nou konte rapò kanpay depi 2016 pou Duncan, 2018 pou Lord ak 2020 pou Ramirez.

2021-2024 actions were read from the eSCRIBE HTML minutes (Jan 20, 2021 to Dec 4, 2024). Roger Coriat held Seat 3 until Ramirez was sworn in on Nov 28, 2022; his votes are in the Coriat column.

Minutes record mover, seconder and "Passed" but no member-by-member vote; all five members attended. Same for 2023-01-18 items 11.a-11.b and 2023-06-21

Special meeting minutes record no member votes; the only action (Legacy Park master plan revision) is town-only and was deferred
Cutler Bay Community Fund grant resolutions name the dollar total but not the not-for-profit recipients; recipients are in the attached exhibits, which were not opened
Consent items carry the single consent-agenda vote, which eSCRIBE repeats under each consent item

name.es: Comisión de la Ciudad de Opa-locka

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Opa-locka City Commission took from August 18, 2021 to October 14, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 164 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. The May 27, 2026 meeting has no minutes posted, and the October 14, 2026 minutes are a draft. The record does not name the applicants for site plans and rezonings. Before 2025, no minutes are posted for the regular meetings of November 22 and December 27, 2023, June 12, October 9, November 27 and December 25, 2024, or the special meetings of September 20 and November 29, 2023. Commissioner Bass's 2018 and 2020 donor reports are not online, so her gifts start with her 2022 campaign.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto de la Comisión de la Ciudad de Opa-locka entre el 18 de agosto de 2021 y el 14 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 164 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. La reunión del 27 de mayo de 2026 no tiene acta publicada, y el acta del 14 de octubre de 2026 es un borrador. El registro no nombra a los solicitantes de planes del sitio y rezonificaciones. Antes de 2025, no hay actas publicadas de las reuniones ordinarias del 22 de noviembre y 27 de diciembre de 2023, ni del 12 de junio, 9 de octubre, 27 de noviembre y 25 de diciembre de 2024, ni de las reuniones especiales del 20 de septiembre y 29 de noviembre de 2023. Los informes de donantes de 2018 y 2020 de la comisionada Bass no están en línea, así que sus donaciones empiezan con su campaña de 2022.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Komisyon Vil Opa-locka te pran ant 18 out 2021 ak 14 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 164 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Reyinyon 27 me 2026 la pa gen pwosè-vèbal pibliye, epi pwosè-vèbal 14 oktòb 2026 la se yon bouyon. Dosye a pa nonmen moun ki fè demann pou plan sit ak nouvo zonaj. Anvan 2025, pa gen pwosè-vèbal pibliye pou reyinyon regilye 22 novanm ak 27 desanm 2023, 12 jen, 9 oktòb, 27 novanm ak 25 desanm 2024, ni pou reyinyon espesyal 20 septanm ak 29 novanm 2023. Rapò donatè 2018 ak 2020 komisyonè Bass yo pa sou entènèt, kidonk don li yo kòmanse ak kanpay 2022 li a.

No quorum; no actions taken
Several consent-agenda votes (2025-05-14, 2025-05-28, 2025-06-11) and the 2025-08-25 lease vote record a 5-0 or 4-0 roll but no mover or second; mover and second are null
Consent items carry the roll of the single consent-agenda vote; pulled items carry their own vote

Applicants for site plans, plats, special exceptions and rezonings (3400 NW 135 St, 14301 NW 27 Ave, 2466 Ali Baba Ave, 13449 NW 42 Ave, 1700 Service Road, 13060 Cairo Lane, 3570/3530/3450 NW 135 St) are not named in the minutes or titles; the contractor on the seven Cairo Lane/NW 127 St change orders and the NW 127 St water-main change order is not named either

Budget hearings (2025-09-09, 2025-09-24, 2026-09-08, 2026-09-23) and special meetings of 2025-11-14 and 2025-11-24 were read; they hold only millage, budget and code items, with no private-party actions
Interlocal agreements, state and federal grants, mutual aid, RFP issuances naming no vendor, code amendments, scholarships and union contracts are excluded under the standard

Bass: her current continuous service began with her appointment on 2021-08-18 (sworn in 2021-09-08) to fill the late Commissioner Alvin Burke's seat; she also served Nov 2018 - Nov 2020 (unexpired Pigatt term) but was off the commission Dec 2020 - Aug 2021, so that earlier term is a separate tenure and is not covered.
Ervin: first sat on 2022-12-14 (elected Nov 2022); actions from 2022-12-14 on are hers. The 2022-11-14 meeting still had the old board (Davis, Dominguez).

Minutes not posted for: Regular meetings 2022-06-08 and 2022-07-13 were read from attachments to later agendas (Opa-Locka RCM Minutes); no minutes found for Regular meetings 2023-11-22, 2023-12-27, 2024-06-12, 2024-10-09, 2024-11-27, 2024-12-25 (agenda only or cancelled), Special meetings 2023-08-16 (cancelled), 2023-09-20, 2023-11-29, Workshop 2021-10-20.

2024-06-12 and 2024-10-09 regular meetings: agenda and packet posted but no minutes attached to any later agenda through Jan 2025; their private-party items (e.g. Landshore Phase II canal contract on 2024-10-09, re-heard 2024-10-23) are not listed for those dates.

Votes come from the clerk's action summary minutes, which list each member's vote. Consent items carry the single consent-agenda roll; pulled items carry their own vote. Where a member is missing from a roll (late arrival, virtual attendance) the vote is "unknown".

Applicants for most site plans, plats, variances, special exceptions and development agreements are not named in the minutes or titles; these carry "Owner of <address> (not named in minutes)" with the owner of record in owners.json.
Older minutes (2021-2022) are scanned PDFs with an OCR text layer; dollar amounts in some titles are garbled and were left out where unreadable.

Excluded under the standard: RFP issuances naming no vendor, budget amendments, code and land development regulation text amendments, interlocal agreements and state/county grants, scholarships, appointments, employment of charter officers, city-hosted events.

name.es: Concejo de la Villa de Key Biscayne

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Key Biscayne Village Council took from November 17, 2022 to October 13, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 61 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. This list goes back to November 2022, when Vazquez and Sardiñas took office. Twelve meetings from that period have agendas but no posted minutes (January 17, February 15, March 14, September 12 and two on September 26, 2023; June 25, September 10, September 24, October 22 and October 23, 2024), so their votes are not shown; later meetings without minutes are handled the same way. The village's campaign finance site could not be read, so their 2022 campaign reports are missing and donor ties on their votes are understated.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto del Concejo de la Villa de Key Biscayne entre el 17 de noviembre de 2022 y el 13 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 61 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. Esta lista se remonta a noviembre de 2022, cuando Vazquez y Sardiñas asumieron el cargo. Doce reuniones de ese periodo tienen agenda pero no actas publicadas (17 de enero, 15 de febrero, 14 de marzo, 12 de septiembre y dos el 26 de septiembre de 2023; 25 de junio, 10 de septiembre, 24 de septiembre, 22 de octubre y 23 de octubre de 2024), así que no se muestran sus votos; las reuniones posteriores sin actas se tratan igual. No se pudo leer el sitio de finanzas de campaña de la villa, así que faltan sus informes de campaña de 2022 y los vínculos con donantes en sus votos están subestimados.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Konsèy Vilaj Key Biscayne te pran ant 17 novanm 2022 ak 13 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 61 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Lis sa a kòmanse an novanm 2022, lè Vazquez ak Sardiñas te pran pòs yo. Douz reyinyon nan peryòd sa a gen ajanda men pa gen pwosè-vèbal pibliye (17 janvye, 15 fevriye, 14 mas, 12 septanm ak de nan 26 septanm 2023; 25 jen, 10 septanm, 24 septanm, 22 oktòb ak 23 oktòb 2024), kidonk vòt yo pa parèt; reyinyon pita ki pa gen pwosè-vèbal trete menm jan an. Nou pa t ka li sit finans kanpay vilaj la, kidonk rapò kanpay 2022 yo manke epi lyen ak donatè sou vòt yo pi piti pase reyalite a.

gaps.issue: Tenure extension (Oct 25, 2026): Vazquez and Sardinas were installed Nov 17, 2022. Granicus posts minutes for 30 of the 41 council meetings from Nov 29, 2022 to Dec 17, 2024 (the Nov 29 and Dec 13, 2022 minutes are scans, read by OCR). No minutes posted for: Jan 17, Feb 15 (regular), Mar 14, Sep 12, Sep 26 (budget and special) 2023; Jun 25, Sep 10, Sep 24, Oct 22, Oct 23 2024. Private-party items from those agendas are listed with roll null.

2022-2024: the 1047 Mariner Drive variance was deferred on Jun 6, 2023 (5-2); its later disposition is not in the posted minutes (the Jul 18, 2023 minutes PDF ends with the resolution title only). The 299 Crandon Boulevard time extensions (Nov 14, 2023) are left out because the property is county library land. Chamber of Commerce, interlocal, grant and union items follow the standard.

Granicus posts minutes for only 12 of the 2025-2026 meetings (2025-01-14 regular and LPA, 2025-02-11, 2025-03-18, 2025-04-08, 2025-05-13 regular and LPA, 2025-06-10, 2025-07-01, 2026-02-10, 2026-04-14, 2026-05-14). Minutes are not included in later agenda packets. Every other council meeting from 2025-08-19 through 2026-10-13, and the 2025-01-28 special meeting, is agenda-only; their private-party agenda items are listed with roll null
Several minutes PDFs are scans with OCR noise; rolls were read from the "voting Yes / voting No" lists and checked by hand for split votes
Councilmember Bracken recused himself on the 12-22-24 Crandon Boulevard site plan; he is marked absent in that roll
Applicants or owners are not named in titles for the variances at 920 Mariner Drive and 640 South Mashta Drive, or for the 101 Harbor Drive rezoning
Workshops (infrastructure, undergrounding, shoreline, swale, budget, Zone 1) take no votes and are not listed

Excluded under the standard: FDEP, FEMA, NOAA, FIND, UASI and county grant and interlocal items, School Board joint use, Supervisor of Elections polling agreement, police union contracts, code amendments and budgets

name.es: Comisión de la Ciudad de Sunny Isles Beach

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Sunny Isles Beach City Commission took from January 5, 2023 to October 15, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 51 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. The list goes back to January 5, 2023, when Svechin was sworn in as mayor (her earlier commission service ended in late 2021). No summary minutes are posted for January 2023 to December 2024, so actions from that period come from the agendas and the votes are not shown; agendas before May 2021 cannot be opened at all. Minutes are posted for 13 of the 27 meetings since 2025; for the rest, the list comes from the agendas. Most votes are voice votes, so a roll is shown only when the minutes give the tally and name any member voting no. The city's campaign finance site could not be read for reports before 2025.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto de la Comisión de la Ciudad de Sunny Isles Beach entre el 5 de enero de 2023 y el 15 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 51 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. La lista se remonta al 5 de enero de 2023, cuando Svechin juró como alcaldesa (su servicio anterior en la comisión terminó a fines de 2021). No hay actas resumidas publicadas de enero de 2023 a diciembre de 2024, así que los actos de ese periodo vienen de las agendas y no se muestran los votos; las agendas anteriores a mayo de 2021 no se pueden abrir. Hay actas publicadas de 13 de las 27 reuniones desde 2025; para las demás, la lista viene de las agendas. La mayoría de los votos son de viva voz, así que solo se muestra la lista de votos cuando el acta da el resultado y nombra a quien votó en contra. No se pudo leer el sitio de finanzas de campaña de la ciudad para informes anteriores a 2025.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Komisyon Vil Sunny Isles Beach te pran ant 5 janvye 2023 ak 15 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 51 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Lis la kòmanse 5 janvye 2023, lè Svechin te prete sèman kòm majistra (sèvis li anvan nan komisyon an te fini nan fen 2021). Pa gen rezime pwosè-vèbal pibliye pou janvye 2023 rive desanm 2024, kidonk aksyon peryòd sa a soti nan ajennda yo epi vòt yo pa parèt; nou pa ka louvri ajennda anvan me 2021 yo ditou. Gen pwosè-vèbal pibliye pou 13 nan 27 reyinyon depi 2025; pou lòt yo, lis la soti nan ajennda yo. Pifò vòt se vòt vwa, kidonk nou montre lis vòt la sèlman lè pwosè-vèbal la bay rezilta a epi nonmen manm ki vote non. Nou pa t ka li sit finans kanpay vil la pou rapò anvan 2025.

gaps.issue: Svechin's current tenure began 2023-01-05, when she was sworn in as mayor after the Dec 6, 2022 runoff. Her earlier service (Seat 1 from Nov 2016; acting mayor Sept-Nov 2021) ended in late 2021: she lost the Nov 2021 mayoral runoff and Seat 1 was filled at the Jan 25 / Feb 8, 2022 special election. For 2023-01 .. 2024-12 the Granicus archive carries agendas and video only; no summary minutes are attached and the clerk memo items (3.A) carry no minutes file, and the Laserfiche records archive (docucenter.sibfl.net) could not be reached. 2023-01-12 .. 2024-12-02 actions are therefore agenda-only (roll unknown; items marked Deferred may not have been heard). Agendas before May 2021 are not readable at all (retired NovusAgenda site)

Agenda PDFs 2023-2024 drop the ti ligature ("Resolu on"); agenda text in notes was repaired only where the full word is attested elsewhere. Excluded from the 2021-2024 pass: employment and separation agreements (Morris, Russo), blanket purchase-order lists for unnamed vendors, RFQ rankings naming only the top-ranked firm, budget and millage, LPA comprehensive plan items

Summary minutes were found for 2025-01-16, 02-20, 03-20, 04-03, 04-17, 05-15, 06-17, 08-21, 09-03, 09-11, 09-18 and 2026-09-17 (draft) and 09-29. For 2025-07-17, 10-16, 11-20 and 2026-03-19, 07-16 and 08-20 the clerk memo attached to the next agenda has no link to the minutes file; minutes for 2026-01-15, 02-19, 04-16, 05-14 and 06-18 were never put on a later agenda. Private-party agenda items from those meetings are listed with roll null
Meeting held; minutes not yet posted. Agenda items listed with roll null
Second budget hearing has video but no agenda or minutes posted

Most resolutions pass by voice vote. Where the minutes give a voice tally equal to the members present and name any dissenters, the roll is filled in from the attendance list (yes for everyone present who is not named as voting no); otherwise roll is null
Vice Mayor Lama absent; Mayor Svechin recused herself at 7:21 p.m. and is marked absent on later items
Local Planning Agency sessions, workshops and special presentation sessions were not read for actions

Excluded: interlocal and FDOT agreements, DOJ forfeiture fund authorizations (the related vendor purchases are listed), PBA collective bargaining agreement, city manager suspension, resignation and separation, proclamations, keys to the city and legislative resolutions

name.es: Registro de cabilderos de la Legislatura de Florida

coverage.en: Every Appropriations Project Request filed for the 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 sessions by the six House members from Miami-Dade who are on the ballot, and by Angie Nixon (District 13, Jacksonville), who is on the ballot for U.S. Senate (484 forms), as posted by the Florida House. Each form names the member who filed it, the group that would receive the money, and the lobbyist working on it, if any. Gifts are from each member’s campaign accounts and any political committee they chair, as filed with the Florida Division of Elections, from the day after the general election before the member’s first session in this list (November 4, 2020; November 9, 2022 for Mike Redondo, who was seated in December 2023; January 2025 for Omar Blanco, first seated in November 2024) to October 2026; for Nixon, also her U.S. Senate campaign’s FEC reports. Each form number was looked up in the final budget the Legislature passed (SB 2500 for 2023-24, HB 5001 for 2024-25, SB 2500 for 2025-26, HB 5001E for 2026-27) and in the governor’s veto list for that year. The list also has these members’ House floor votes on every bill that became law in the 2023 through 2026 sessions where the Legislature’s own staff analysis says the bill helps a kind of business, with gifts from donors in that kind of business.
coverage.es: Todas las solicitudes de proyectos presupuestarios (Appropriations Project Requests) presentadas para las sesiones de 2023, 2024, 2025 y 2026 por los seis representantes de Miami-Dade que están en la boleta, y por Angie Nixon (Distrito 13, Jacksonville), que está en la boleta para el Senado de EE. UU. (484 formularios), según los publica la Cámara de Florida. Cada formulario nombra al miembro que la presentó, al grupo que recibiría el dinero y al cabildero que trabaja en ella, si lo hay. Las donaciones son de las cuentas de campaña de cada miembro y de cualquier comité político que preside, según los reportes a la División de Elecciones de Florida, desde el día después de la elección general anterior a la primera sesión del miembro en esta lista (4 de noviembre de 2020; 9 de noviembre de 2022 para Mike Redondo, que entró en diciembre de 2023; enero de 2025 para Omar Blanco, que entró en noviembre de 2024) hasta octubre de 2026; en el caso de Nixon, también los reportes de su campaña al Senado ante la FEC. Cada número de formulario se buscó en el presupuesto final aprobado por la Legislatura (SB 2500 para 2023-24, HB 5001 para 2024-25, SB 2500 para 2025-26, HB 5001E para 2026-27) y en la lista de vetos del gobernador de ese año. La lista también tiene los votos de estos miembros en el pleno de la Cámara sobre cada proyecto que se convirtió en ley en las sesiones de 2023 a 2026 cuando el propio análisis del personal legislativo dice que el proyecto ayuda a un tipo de negocio, con las donaciones de donantes de ese tipo de negocio.
coverage.ht: Tout demann pwojè bidjè (Appropriations Project Requests) sis reprezantan Miami-Dade ki sou bilten an te depoze pou sesyon 2023, 2024, 2025 ak 2026 yo, ak Angie Nixon (Distri 13, Jacksonville), ki sou bilten an pou Sena Etazini (484 fòm), jan Chanm Florid pibliye yo. Chak fòm nonmen manm ki te depoze l la, gwoup ki ta resevwa lajan an, ak lobiyis k ap travay sou li, si genyen. Kado yo soti nan kont kanpay chak manm ak nenpòt komite politik li prezide, jan yo depoze yo nan Divizyon Eleksyon Florid, depi jou apre eleksyon jeneral ki te vin anvan premye sesyon manm nan nan lis sa a (4 novanm 2020; 9 novanm 2022 pou Mike Redondo, ki te antre an desanm 2023; janvye 2025 pou Omar Blanco, ki te antre an novanm 2024) rive oktòb 2026; pou Nixon, tou rapò FEC kanpay li pou Sena a. Nou chèche chak nimewo fòm nan bidjè final Lejislati a te vote a (SB 2500 pou 2023-24, HB 5001 pou 2024-25, SB 2500 pou 2025-26, HB 5001E pou 2026-27) ak nan lis veto gouvènè a pou ane sa a. Lis la gen tou vòt manm sa yo nan sesyon plenyè Chanm nan sou chak pwojè ki te tounen lwa nan sesyon 2023 rive 2026 lè analiz anplwaye Lejislati a menm di pwojè a ede yon kalite biznis, ak kado donatè nan kalite biznis sa a.

note.en: Floor vote: Passed as amended by Conference Committee Report. The staff analysis says the bill helps hospitals and nursing homes: “increasing the QIP pool percentage”. note.ht: Vòt nan sesyon plenyè. Analiz anplwaye a di pwojè a ede lopital ak mezon retrèt (sitasyon an angle): “increasing the QIP pool percentage”. Kado yo parèt ak dat yo anrejistre, menm sa ki vini apre vòt la. Pwojè a te tounen lwa (Ch. 2026-236).

note.en: Floor vote: Passed as amended by Conference Committee Report. The staff analysis says the bill helps lottery retailers: “require the commission for lottery ticket sales to be set at 6 percent”. Donors listed are lottery retailers, as their names and reported occupations appear in the campaign finance reports; this does not claim they asked for the bill or for this vote. Gifts are shown with the dates recorded, including any after the vote. The bill became law (Ch. 2025-199).

subject.en: Disaster Relief
subject.es: Disaster Relief
subject.ht: Disaster Relief

note.en: Floor vote: third reading. The staff analysis says the bill helps farmers and timber landowners: “The bill provides tax relief to agricultural producers affected by Hurricane Idalia ... eligible timber landowners will benefit from cost sharing grants for site preparation and tree replanting.”. Donors listed are farmers and timber landowners, as their names and reported occupations appear in the campaign finance reports; this does not claim they asked for the bill or for this vote. Gifts are shown with the dates recorded, including any after the vote. The bill became law (Ch. 2023-349).
note.es: Votación en el pleno. El análisis del personal dice que el proyecto beneficia a agricultores y dueños de tierras madereras (cita en inglés): “The bill provides tax relief to agricultural producers affected by Hurricane Idalia ... eligible timber landowners will benefit from cost sharing grants for site preparation and tree replanting.”. Los donantes que aparecen son agricultores y dueños de tierras madereras, según sus nombres y ocupaciones en los reportes de campaña; esto no afirma que pidieran el proyecto ni este voto. Las donaciones se muestran con las fechas registradas, incluso las posteriores al voto. El proyecto se convirtió en ley (Ch. 2023-349).
note.ht: Vòt nan sesyon plenyè. Analiz anplwaye a di pwojè a ede kiltivatè ak pwopriyetè tè bwa (sitasyon an angle): “The bill provides tax relief to agricultural producers affected by Hurricane Idalia ... eligible timber landowners will benefit from cost sharing grants for site preparation and tree replanting.”. Donatè ki parèt yo se kiltivatè ak pwopriyetè tè bwa, jan non yo ak okipasyon yo parèt nan rapò kanpay yo; sa pa di yo te mande pwojè lwa a ni vòt sa a. Kado yo parèt ak dat yo anrejistre, menm sa ki vini apre vòt la. Pwojè a te tounen lwa (Ch. 2023-349).

note.en: Floor vote: third reading. The staff analysis says the bill helps rebuilding and beach repair contractors: “those involved in post-disaster recovery, including housing repair or development and beach erosion control construction, will benefit from state expenditures”. Donors listed are rebuilding and beach repair contractors, as their names and reported occupations appear in the campaign finance reports; this does not claim they asked for the bill or for this vote. Gifts are shown with the dates recorded, including any after the vote. The bill became law (Ch. 2022-272).
note.es: Votación en el pleno. El análisis del personal dice que el proyecto beneficia a contratistas de reconstrucción y de playas (cita en inglés): “those involved in post-disaster recovery, including housing repair or development and beach erosion control construction, will benefit from state expenditures”. Los donantes que aparecen son contratistas de reconstrucción y de playas, según sus nombres y ocupaciones en los reportes de campaña; esto no afirma que pidieran el proyecto ni este voto. Las donaciones se muestran con las fechas registradas, incluso las posteriores al voto. El proyecto se convirtió en ley (Ch. 2022-272).
note.ht: Vòt nan sesyon plenyè. name.es: Registro de cabilderos de la Legislatura de Florida

coverage.en: Every Local Funding Initiative Request filed for fiscal years 2021-22 through 2026-27 by the senators in this list (1466 forms), as posted by the Florida Senate: Ileana Garcia and Ana Maria Rodriguez from their first session (seated November 2020), Alexis Calatayud and Blaise Ingoglia from November 2022 (Ingoglia until he became Chief Financial Officer in July 2025). Each form names the senator who filed it, the group that would receive the money, and the lobbyist working on it, if any. Gifts are from each senator’s campaign account and any political committee they chair, as filed with the Florida Division of Elections, from the day after the general election before the senator was first seated (November 7, 2018 for Garcia and Rodriguez; November 4, 2020 for Calatayud and Ingoglia) to October 2026. Each form number was looked up in the final budget the Legislature passed for that year (SB 2500 for 2021-22, HB 5001 for 2022-23, SB 2500 for 2023-24, HB 5001 for 2024-25, SB 2500 for 2025-26, HB 5001E for 2026-27) and in the governor’s veto list; some forms are funded only through budget wording that gives no separate amount. Lobbying firms are matched against the Legislature’s lobbying-firm directories for 2020 through 2026. Ashley Gantt, a House member running for the Senate, is listed with the House. The list also has these senators’ floor votes on every bill that became law in the 2021 through 2026 sessions where the Legislature’s own staff analysis says the bill helps a kind of business, with gifts from donors in that kind of business. Not included: chapter law 2022-150, which the Senate’s list of bills that became law does not show; and the budget bills themselves (the General Appropriations Acts and their implementing and conforming bills), whose only analyses are conference reports with no private-sector section.
coverage.es: Todas las solicitudes de fondos locales (Local Funding Initiative Requests) presentadas para los años fiscales 2021-22 a 2026-27 por los senadores de esta lista (1466 formularios), según los publica el Senado de Florida: Ileana Garcia y Ana Maria Rodriguez desde su primera sesión (entraron en noviembre de 2020), Alexis Calatayud y Blaise Ingoglia desde noviembre de 2022 (Ingoglia hasta que se convirtió en Director de Finanzas en julio de 2025). Cada formulario nombra al senador que la presentó, al grupo que recibiría el dinero y al cabildero que trabaja en ella, si lo hay. Las donaciones son de la cuenta de campaña de cada senador y de cualquier comité político que preside, según los reportes a la División de Elecciones de Florida, desde el día después de la elección general anterior a la entrada del senador (7 de noviembre de 2018 para Garcia y Rodriguez; 4 de noviembre de 2020 para Calatayud e Ingoglia) hasta octubre de 2026. Cada número de formulario se buscó en el presupuesto final aprobado por la Legislatura para ese año (SB 2500 para 2021-22, HB 5001 para 2022-23, SB 2500 para 2023-24, HB 5001 para 2024-25, SB 2500 para 2025-26, HB 5001E para 2026-27) y en la lista de vetos del gobernador; algunos formularios se financian solo mediante texto del presupuesto que no indica una cantidad aparte. Las firmas de cabildeo se comparan con los directorios de firmas de cabildeo de la Legislatura de 2020 a 2026. Ashley Gantt, representante que se postula al Senado, aparece con la Cámara. La lista también tiene los votos en el pleno de estos senadores sobre cada proyecto que se convirtió en ley en las sesiones de 2021 a 2026 cuando el propio análisis del personal legislativo dice que el proyecto ayuda a un tipo de negocio, con las donaciones de donantes de ese tipo de negocio. No se incluyen: la ley 2022-150, que la lista del Senado de proyectos convertidos en ley no muestra; ni los proyectos de presupuesto (las Leyes Generales de Asignaciones y sus proyectos de implementación y conformidad), cuyos únicos análisis son informes de conferencia sin sección sobre el sector privado.
coverage.ht: Tout demann finansman lokal (Local Funding Initiative Requests) senatè nan lis sa a te depoze pou ane fiskal 2021-22 rive 2026-27 (1466 fòm), jan Sena Florid pibliye yo: Ileana Garcia ak Ana Maria Rodriguez depi premye sesyon yo (yo te antre an novanm 2020), Alexis Calatayud ak Blaise Ingoglia depi novanm 2022 (Ingoglia jiskaske li te vin Ofisye Finans an jiyè 2025). Chak fòm nonmen senatè ki te depoze l la, gwoup ki ta resevwa lajan an, ak lobiyis k ap travay sou li, si genyen. Kado yo soti nan kont kanpay chak senatè ak nenpòt komite politik li prezide, jan yo depoze yo nan Divizyon Eleksyon Florid, depi jou apre eleksyon jeneral ki te vin anvan senatè a te antre (7 novanm 2018 pou Garcia ak Rodriguez; 4 novanm 2020 pou Calatayud ak Ingoglia) rive oktòb 2026. Nou chèche chak nimewo fòm nan bidjè final Lejislati a te vote pou ane sa a (SB 2500 pou 2021-22, HB 5001 pou 2022-23, SB 2500 pou 2023-24, HB 5001 pou 2024-25, SB 2500 pou 2025-26, HB 5001E pou 2026-27) ak nan lis veto gouvènè a; gen kèk fòm ki jwenn lajan sèlman atravè tèks bidjè a ki pa bay yon kantite apa. Nou konpare fèm lobiyis yo ak anyè fèm lobiyis Lejislati a pou 2020 rive 2026. Ashley Gantt, yon reprezantan k ap kouri pou Sena a, parèt ak Chanm nan. Lis la gen tou vòt senatè sa yo nan sesyon plenyè sou chak pwojè ki te tounen lwa nan sesyon 2021 rive 2026 lè analiz anplwaye Lejislati a menm di pwojè a ede yon kalite biznis, ak kado donatè nan kalite biznis sa a. Sa ki pa ladan l: lwa 2022-150, ke lis Sena a pou pwojè ki te tounen lwa pa montre; ak pwojè bidjè yo menm (Lwa Jeneral Afektasyon yo ak pwojè aplikasyon ak konfòmite yo), paske sèl analiz yo se rapò konferans ki pa gen seksyon sou sektè prive a.
